A brief gallery of artwork depicting the character Storm, from the X-Men comics, but specifically in her Punk Rock/Mohawk style.

The artists are, in order of appearence:

Ohnojustino (1), Wintonkid (2), Penerotic (3), Fenris comix (4), Robinx (5), Dima Ivanov (6-7), Flhour (8), Renato Camilo (9), Monolithic Sloth (10), Sunsetriders7 (11), Wrenzephir2 (12), Tharrek (13-14), Japes (15), Deeaquifolium (16), Lucas Silva (17).
